Localized on 2026-07-27 for the BEAVER/Beta handoff.

- `PilotoStudio1_RuntimeSubset/`: only the 30 runtime dependencies used by the oxygen-leak presentation. Moved from the ignored Piloto Studio source folder with original `.meta` GUIDs intact.
- `Fonts/Maplestory Light SDF.asset`: project-used modified TMP font asset, moved from `Assets/99. DownloadAssets/` with its GUID intact.
